items.title: The Raven's Mistake
items.explanation: The Raven croaked because he forgot that his voice was just a croak, not a song. He opened his beak in his foolish pride to eat the morsel the Fox had given him.

items.title: The Fox's Wisdom
items.explanation: The Fox is shown to be cunning in stories because he recognized that the Raven was too proud and did not understand that his voice was just a croak, leading to the loss of food.
